recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the intended core Medication example correction with a valid current RxNorm code/display and does not require follow-up in the FHIR core checkout for FHIR-36498.
issue_request: FHIR-36498 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core Medication. It asked to correct Medication example 0317 because the page described KCl in D5W while the ingredients implied normal saline and because KCl 2 mEq/mL did not make sense as the final strength. The supplied correction specified KCl 20 meq/1000 mL and dextrose 5 g/100 mL.
initial_application: Commit 8f82213bf87400686774b008004600415dfc5e74 partially applied the issue to source/medication/medicationexample0317.xml by changing the potassium chloride code/strength and the second ingredient strength. It left the second ingredient code as RxNorm 313002. Later QA/display commits c38eadd123b694739f07a7066ce9e249abc458db and 445fa7490950755ffad8307faf2e801fd01d9ae5 made the current meaning of 313002 visible as sodium chloride, leaving the D5W example semantically wrong.
additional_context: Medication is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/medication/list-Medication-examples.xml lists medicationexample0317 with the D5W description. FHIR-36758 is a same-artifact supporting decision that uses KCl 20 mEq in 1 L D5W as a Medication.ingredient.strength example. Separate MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, and MedicationRequest examples that contain a local med0317 still describe 0.9% normal saline in their own dosage text, so they were treated as separate normal-saline examples rather than part of this Medication-page correction.
reconciliation: Changed source/medication/medicationexample0317.xml so the second ingredient uses RxNorm 1795612 with display "1000 ML glucose 50 MG/ML Injection" and CodeableConcept text "Dextrose 5% injectable solution". The already-correct KCl 20 meq/1000 mL and dextrose 5 g/100 mL strengths were preserved.
source_changes: source/medication/medicationexample0317.xml: changed the second ingredient coding from RxNorm 313002/sodium chloride to RxNorm 1795612/1000 ML glucose 50 MG/ML Injection and changed the text to Dextrose 5% injectable solution.
